subject: RELATIONSHIP VERIFICATION
main_text: This is to certify that Mr. Aaditya Joshi, grandson of Mr. Pitambar Joshi, son of Mr. Devkant Joshi and Mrs. Yashoda Kumari Bhatta Joshi, a permanent resident of Nagarjun Municipality, Ward No. 10, Kathmandu District, Bagmati Province, Nepal, (Previously: Syuchatar V.D.C, Ward No. 2, Kathmandu District, Bagmati Province, Nepal). This certificate is issued according to Chapter 3, Section 12, Sub-Section 2, Clause (E), Sub-Clause (1) of the Local Government Operation Act 2074 B.S. (2017 A.D.). As per the application processed in this office, the following members are the relatives of the applicant as mentioned below.
